concepts.label: Creating Search Indexes (FTS concept page - PUT/REST-based index creation and update)

notable_absence.finding: No role/privilege is restated on this specific 'creating indexes' page (it only appears on fts-introduction.md as a general FTS Admin/FTS Searcher statement). Also no structural links (no markdown links at all in this file) - it is a short, isolated, older-style narrative page describing PUT-based index creation/update via UI, SDK, or REST, distinct from both the N1QL reference template and the newer search/ Web-Console task pages (create-quick-index.md, create-type-mapping.md, create-child-field.md) which describe the same underlying activity through a GUI wizard.

cross_component_finding.observation: This page and the newer search/ task pages (create-quick-index.md, create-search-index-alias.md, create-type-mapping.md, create-child-field.md) both describe 'creating a Search/FTS index', but from very different angles: this page describes the raw PUT/REST mechanism and a uuid-based update-safety rule ('Specifying the "uuid" parameter in the index definition is required for the index introduction to be treated as a valid update'), while the search/ pages describe the Web Console Quick Editor / full editor wizard. Neither cross-references the other. Consistent with the fts/ vs search/ doc-generation overlap already flagged in a prior batch (fts-delete-index.json).
cross_component_finding.evidence: The PUT request is the only way to create/update indexes. If the user does it from the UI/SDK - it will be translated to HTTP PUT requests and executed by curl.

competency_questions_addressed: How are FTS indexes created and updated at the REST/API level, and what safety rule governs updates?
